title: Pipelines | Changing a deal's pipeline does not ask which stage the deal should move to
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) · account mahmoud.mahamed1515 (CRM Admin); test user 1 / test user 2 where noted

panels.caption: Deal → Pipeline → "1": the dialog asks "Stage in the new pipeline" (qualification, kept because "1" has it too).
Change pipeline → PATCH 422 toast with the raw pipeline id; deal stays Standard / qualification.
Shared staging blocker card: the Deals Pipeline pick-list field allows only "Standard (Standard)", so every deal write that sends a pipeline — "1" or even the default Standard — is refused with 422.

rows: Dialog asks for the stage in the new pipeline
